profile.headline: Java Full Stack Developer | Actively looking for new opportunities | No sponsorship required #FullStackDeveloper #Java #Angular #SoftwareEngineer
profile.summary: Highly Trusted, Motivated IT Professional with an impeccable 5 years of experience in system Analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, and support of application software using Object Oriented Analysis and Design in JAVA/J2EE. Expertise in Design, Development and Implementationrobust enterprise Java applications based on well-known design techniques, principles and patterns. A high level of Expertise in developing and designing web applications utilizing Core Java, J2EE, JSP, Servlets, Java Beans, EJB, JSF, Spring, Springboot, Hibernate, Web Services (SOAP, WSDL, UDDI), JMS, JDBC, XML, HTML, XHTML, HTML5, CSS, DHTML, JavaScript, XSLT, JSON, Ajax, Angular.JS/2/4, JQuery, JSON.

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on Loan Origination System customization and other internal projects for Impac. Worked on BKFS EMPOWER Customization project for Impac. Worked on Designed and developed custom Wholesale portal to replace LPS EMPOWER Fusion portal using API integration. Worked on design and development of Impacs’s platform APIs.

•	Hands on experience with RESTful web services,performed system level web service troubleshooting, verification and testing
•	Designed and developed Microservices using Spring boot application
•	Implemented server-side architecture using Maven, Spring framework
•	Spring framework configuration for business logic layer with XML bean configuration files
•	Collaborated with architects and senior engineers to design unattended deployment framework and ultimately reduced deployment time
•	Participated in daily scrum calls and weekly status check-in meetings with extended teams, including team members from different time zones
•	Developed Controller classes in Spring MVC framework in the web layer
•	Extensively used Eclipse based STS IDE for building, developing and integrating the application
•	AWS EC2 Configurion and deployment 
•	Converted a monolithic application to Microservices architecture using Spring Boot using 12-factor app methodology 
•	Deployed, scaled, and configured using manifest file for various Microservices in PCF.microservices
•	Securing Java based systems using Spring Security (OAuth 2.0) and Spring-managed servlet filters
•	Developed solutions for leveraging the breadth of marketplace services, include spring cloud services (eureka, config, hystrix)
•	Integrated apps with Spring Cloud marketplace services (Config server, Eureka/Service Discovery, Circuit-breaker Dashboard)
•	Implemented Angular Router to enable navigation from one view to the next as customer performs application tasks
•	Created Angular service and integration with RESTful APIs. Used Angular HttpClient to send GET/POST request to fetch data from server

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on development of Cordys BPM product especially Collaborative Business Object Cache (CoBOC) module. CoBOC provides transaction space for business objects and acts as a central repository. CoBoC is a subcomponent of Cordys Orchestrator Component. Key responsibilities include refactoring module designs and delivering innovative solutions for performance enhancements, Requirements Gathering for new feature, Technical Design, development of new features and performance improvement fixes.

•	Implemented application using Springboot with JPA, Spring Framework, Spring dependency injection, Spring MVC for Rest API’s and integrated with the Hibernate
•	Used Hibernate to access data from the DB. Maintained and configured all the Hibernate POJO's using annotations needed for the DB
•	Involved with front end (UI) development using Angular 4, BootStrap, JavaScript, JQuery, HTML5, CSS3.
•	Involved in designing and creating the Database Tables using PostgreSQL Database
•	Worked on Liquibase which is a source control database
•	Involved in implementation of CI (Continuous Integration) using Jenkins. And involved in configuring pipeline using Blue Ocean Pipeline for project build on Jenkins
•	Used Hibernate to store the persistence data into the PostgreSQL database and wrote HQL to access the data from the database
•	Tested, debugged and implemented the application using JUnit for unit testing used SVN,GIT and Bit bucket Repository as Version control tools
•	Implemented Ansible playbooks for application deployment on a new Virtual Server
•	Used JHipster application framework to develop the application
•	Implemented and Configured JHipster project. Used Spring Boot Framework to java development
•	Extensively Worked with Intellij as the IDE to develop, test and deploy the complete application
•	Successfully executed all the test cases and fixed any bugs/issues identified during the test cycles

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Contributed to the development of CA Unicenter Web Services Distributed Management (WSDM). I was a primary resource to handle development of the Unicenter WSDM Instrumentation Wizard and other instrumentation tools. WSDM is a state-of-the-art management solution for any service-oriented architecture (SOA) environment. It provides essential visibility and control for Web services, enabling user to observe and proactively maintain service and performance degradations. Key responsibilities include Requirements Gathering for new feature, Technical Design, development of new features and issues resolutions.
